definitions.explanation: Dried tobacco leaves or a cigarette for smoking.

examples.japanese: ここではたばこを{吸|す}わないでください。

notes:
たばこ means tobacco or cigarette. Can be written in hiragana, katakana (タバコ), or kanji ({煙草|たばこ}).

ETYMOLOGY:
From Portuguese "tabaco."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- たばこを{吸|す}う: to smoke
- たばこを{止|や}める: to quit smoking
- たばこを{買|か}う: to buy cigarettes

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {喫煙|きつえん}: smoking (formal term)
- {喫煙所|きつえんじょ}: smoking area
- {禁煙|きんえん}: no smoking
- {灰皿|はいざら}: ashtray
- {電子|でんし}たばこ: e-cigarette

SOCIAL NOTE:
Smoking restrictions have increased in Japan. Many public spaces are now {禁煙|きんえん} (no smoking).
